title: Algorithmovigilance, lifecycle cadence, drift, and incident monitoring
purpose: Monitors technical, clinical, workflow, equity, economic, and trust indicators against warning and stop thresholds over time.
input: `Monitoring` sheet with date, indicator, domain, value, subgroup, model_version; `Thresholds` sheet with indicator, direction, warning threshold, stop threshold, owner, and response.
outputs: Indicator status by date, warning/stop events, version comparison, subgroup signals, trend charts, and response register.
limitations: This is an educational example. It is not a clinical device, validated decision instrument, or substitute for local statistical, economic, legal, privacy, cybersecurity, ethics, quality, or health-technology-assessment review.
